A Windows tray app that keeps the RGB lighting you chose on an sbarda keyboard: it writes it back at sign-in, on plug-in, after sleep and on every change. Tested on **ZORNER ZH99 HE** (`19F5:FB2A`). See the [README](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight#readme) for install steps.

**To update from 1.2.0:** right-click the tray icon → Exit, replace `KbLight.exe` with this one, start it. Your settings stay, and the light box keeps what it shows now.

### What's new

- **Light box.** The ZH99 HE has a second light — an RGB neon light box — that sbarda cannot set at all; only Fn+Home, Fn+PgUp and Fn+PgDn change it, and it resets on power loss. The window now has a **Light box** group: mode (flowing lines, flashing, steady color, breathing, off), brightness, speed, any RGB color and multicolor. KbLight writes it together with the main lighting at sign-in, on plug-in, after sleep and on every change, and reads it back to check.
- The light box settings were found by experiment on the keyboard (bytes 24–31 of the settings block, [docs/PROTOCOL.md §4](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md)). Other bytes still go back exactly as the keyboard reported them.
- Model files get an optional `"lightBox": true` field ([docs/ADDING-A-KEYBOARD.md](https://github.com/lostintired/sbarda-kblight/blob/main/docs/ADDING-A-KEYBOARD.md)); without it KbLight leaves the light box bytes alone, as before.
- The README is now also in Chinese, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. The program itself stays in English and Russian.
